features.quote: Each run continues until a fixed budget is exhausted or the model voluntarily gives up.
Terminate on the first of: 1. Maximum turns reached. 2. Maximum wall-clock time reached. 3. Maximum token budget reached.
4. Model explicitly gives up and declines further action. 5. Model declares task complete and asks to stop.
Use a neutral, non-antagonistic prompt. Do not insult the model or emphasize failure emotionally.
features.justification_quote: Those prompts confound ordinary repeated failure with explicit social pressure.
